known_limitations: Album labels Music/M3e Client Audio differ from the reference embedded album/track tags; the blank album page prevented either audio item from being selected or decoded.
Both subtitle display labels are en despite distinct srt/vtt codecs; no subtitle response was received in the failed selection run.
The Goby Series page adds duplicate owned episodes under Specials; request booleans are retained exactly without inferred values.
Caught-exception runs are diagnostic-only and cannot establish playback timing acceptance.
The existing independent logout proof has no atomic cancellation hook if an instance changes; all recorded run identity checks passed against the continuously frozen source11 candidate.
